messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#1643] rmr2 Error
parts:
On Mon, Sep 1, 2014 at 3:10 AM, 곽두현 <doo...@gmail.com> wrote:
Error in loadNamespace(name) : there is no package called ‘rmr2’

How could this error message be more clear? If you have installed rmr2 on every node it's an issue of users or permissions or environment. Best bet is to install as root to a system path like /usr/bin.


Antonio
